desc: Fix mutable default arguments in prompts.py
context: app/prompts/prompts.py has two mutable default argument bugs (smell-01, smell-02). (1) render_prompt() at line ~150 uses additional_vars: dict = {} — replace with additional_vars: dict = None and add body: additional_vars = additional_vars or {}. (2) PromptList.__init__() at line ~19 uses variables=[] — replace with variables=None and add body: variables = variables or []. Both are Python anti-patterns where the same mutable object is shared across all calls using the default.
acceptance_criteria: render_prompt() signature uses additional_vars: dict = None
render_prompt() body initializes additional_vars = additional_vars if additional_vars is not None else {}
PromptList.__init__() body initializes variables = variables if variables is not None else []
cd app && poetry run pytest tests/test_prompts.py -x passes
